sloka: वाल व्यजन हस्ताभिर् वीज्यमानम् समन्ततः ।गन्धैः च विविधैर् जुष्टम् वर धूपेन धूपितम् ॥५-१०-५॥
transliteration: vāla vyajana hastābhir vījyamānam samantataḥ ।gandhaiḥ ca vividhair juṣṭam vara dhūpena dhūpitam ॥5-10-5॥

translations.english: He saw an exquisite couch made of gold shining wonderfully like the Sun. It was decorated with ashoka flowers. Women were holding fans of chamari deer. It was upholstered with the best of bedspreads made of soft sheep skin and adorned with beautiful strings of flower garlands. Scented with aromatic smoke, it was refreshed with fragrance which had spread all over the place.
